subject: Expansion: onboarding three additional product teams + term amendment

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@helixanalytics.com>

Subject: Expansion: onboarding three additional product teams + term question

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Thanks again for the great kickoff last week — Helix is excited about the initial pilot results. We have an ask from product leadership: they want to roll Redwood out to three more internal teams (Data Platform, Product Insights, and Mobile SDK). High level: they need separate API keys, predictable throughput for a staging window, and an updated commercial term that extends our committed capacity by 6 months (aligned with our next fiscal planning).

Can you confirm:
- How many distinct API keys do we need and what's the provisioning lead time?
- Can we get a short proposal that shows incremental monthly cost for +3 teams and the impact of extending the term (prorated credits / discount)?
- Any concerns about token throughput for the initial ramp — we’re estimating ~10k tokens/minute at peak across these teams.

Attached is a short internal map of the teams and ownership (Helix-MAP.docx). Procurement will need a sample amendment to review.

Next step: can we do a 30-minute sync Thursday morning? Sara

--
Sara Liu
Head of Product Operations | Helix Analytics
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding three additional product teams + term question

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP doc. Short answers up front:
- We can provision 3 distinct API keys the same day for non-production; production keys we usually issue within 24–48 hours after the security checklist is complete.
- I’ll attach a draft amendment with two options: (A) 6-month term extension with a 7% usage credit, and (B) 12-month add-on with tiered committed capacity and a 12% credit. I’ll send cost sketches for both.
- Peak 10k tokens/min should be fine with modest burst capacity. Rishi, can you confirm whether a temporary dedicated pool or autoscaled shared capacity is better here?

I’m available Thursday 10:00–10:45 PT for the sync. If that works, I’ll share a short runbook for key provisioning and a sample amendment for procurement.

Best,
Mateo

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 11:05 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll attach a draft amendment with two options...

Sara / team — quick technical note: 10k tokens/min peak across three teams is ~600k tokens/hour. For ramping we recommend:
- Phase 1 (staging, weeks 1–2): shared autoscaled pool, rate-limits per-key (safe, lowest ops overhead).
- Phase 2 (production, weeks 3–6): move to a small dedicated pool (1 GPU node) if sustained 200k+ tokens/hour, or keep autoscale with reserved burst if usage is spiky.

For keys: we will create 1 key per team + 1 integration key for your platform team (4 keys total). Keys are tagged by environment (staging/prod).

I attached a capacity sketch (capacity-estimate-10k-tokens.csv) and will be prepared to walk through the runbook on Thursday.

—Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Thu 10:00 PT. Attaching the draft amendment for procurement to review (redwood-draft-amendment.pdf).

Sara — procurement note: the draft includes two commercial options (Mateo's options A/B). We propose the 6-month extension (Option A) as the fastest path: it preserves your current renewal cadence but gives the teams time to validate ROI. If procurement prefers a single longer commitment, Option B will require a short discount approval (we can fast-track).

Agenda for Thursday (30 minutes):
- 5m: goals + expected timeline from Helix leadership
- 10m: Rishi on provisioning, tagging, and rate limits
- 10m: Commercial options and amendment walk-through
- 5m: Next steps + procurement path (DocuSign expectations)

Laura Bennett

Thanks — Thursday worked well. Procurement reviewed the amendment and prefers Option A (6-month extension with the 7% usage credit) to keep our renewal cycle intact. They also asked for:
- A one-page appendix that lists the four API keys and how they're scoped (we need clear names for the keys in the amendment).
- A brief SSO/KMS note for our security team (they will request an ROE).

Can you produce the appendix and the SSO/KMS blurb by Wednesday so procurement can circulate internally? Also, can we plan key creation for next Monday (provisioning in staging first)?

If you want, we can push for DocuSign once the appendix is in place — procurement said the legal review should be short after that.

Sara
